choices: A new copy of the list that cannot be changed
A view of the list that throws UnsupportedOperationException on mutating operations
A null-safe wrapper around the list
A synchronized version of the list
explanation: unmodifiableList() returns a view backed by the original list. Reads work; any mutating call (add, remove, set) throws UnsupportedOperationException. Changes to the underlying list ARE reflected in the view. For a true immutable copy: List.copyOf(list) (Java 10+).
